title.ko: 초록 쓰기: This study examines · The findings indicate · It is concluded that
title.en: writing abstracts: this study examines, the findings indicate, it is concluded that

explain.ko: 초록(abstract)은 논문의 목적, 방법, 결과, 결론을 간결하게 요약한 글입니다. 첫 문장에서 연구 목적을 밝히고(This study examines ...), 방법은 과거 시제와 수동태로(A survey was conducted ...), 결과는 과거나 현재 시제로(The findings indicate that ...), 결론은 현재 시제로 제시합니다. 연구의 한계와 시사점을 짧게 언급하면 완성도가 높아집니다. 분량은 보통 150~250단어입니다.
explain.en: An abstract concisely summarises a paper's aim, method, results and conclusion. The first sentence states the aim (This study examines ...), the method uses past tense and passive (A survey was conducted ...), results use past or present (The findings indicate that ...), and conclusions use present tense. A brief mention of limitations and implications improves it. Length is usually 150–250 words.

lines.t: An abstract is a short summary of a whole paper. It should present the aim, method, main results and conclusion in order. Present and past tenses are distinguished, and the passive is often used. The length is normally within 150 words.

trans.ko: 초록은 논문 전체를 짧게 요약한 글입니다. 연구 목적, 방법, 주요 결과, 결론이 순서대로 들어가야 합니다. 현재 시제와 과거 시제를 구분해 쓰고, 수동태를 자주 사용합니다. 분량은 보통 백오십 단어 이내입니다.

ABSTRACT
Urban green space and health
This study analysed the relationship between urban green space and residents' health. Survey and health-check data were collected from five hundred Seoul residents. The results show that more green space is associated with lower stress. This has implications for urban planning.

prompt.en: Write a four-sentence abstract of an imaginary study in the order aim, method, results, conclusion.

task.model: This study examines the relationship between sleep duration and academic achievement. A survey was conducted with one hundred university students. The findings indicate that longer sleep tends to be associated with higher grades. Although the sample is small, the results have important implications for education policy, and further research is needed.

model_trans.ko: 이 연구는 수면 시간과 학업 성취의 관계를 조사한다. 백 명의 대학생을 대상으로 설문 조사를 실시하였다. 결과는 수면 시간이 길수록 성적이 높은 경향이 있음을 보여 준다. 표본이 작지만 교육 정책에 중요한 시사점을 제공하며 추가 연구가 필요하다.
model_trans.en: This study examines the relationship between sleep duration and academic achievement. A survey was conducted with one hundred university students. The findings indicate that longer sleep tends to be associated with higher grades. Although the sample is small, the results have important implications for education policy, and further research is needed.
